findings.disposition: folded - figure repair on nova:sub-millisecond-forward-path section 6
findings.summary: The plasma cells are the figure's subject and its faintest mark: measured over the rendered PNG the cell outlines measure 1.76:1 median contrast against white (median sRGB 204,189,227; 99.8% of mesh pixels under 3:1), the colour being #a98fd0 at alpha 0.45. In the full-machine panel (156 px wide, 9 px cell pitch) the hexagons merge into a lavender tint at column width, so the left panel cannot be read as a 558-cell mesh the way the caption describes it; only the zoomed panel shows cells distinctly.

findings.disposition: folded - figure repair on nova:sub-millisecond-forward-path section 6: give the section outlines a readable minimum size or a stated note in the caption
findings.summary: Two coil sections render at roughly 0.25 m and appear as 9x9 px diamonds, and in the zoom a third appears as a detached 8x3 px grey mark above the vessel apex (x 1012-1019, y 72-74), separated from every other outline. All are drawn in the coil colour the legend names, but at these sizes a reader cannot tell them from rendering debris: the mark above the apex has no neighbouring geometry to read it against.

findings.disposition: folded - figure repair on nova:sub-millisecond-forward-path section 6: allocate the two panels unequal widths so the zoom carries more of the canvas
findings.summary: Equal aspect plus a 14x7.2 in single-row layout letterboxes both panels: the left drawing occupies 409 of ~690 panel px and the right 291, and the rendered canvas carries ink on 4.5% of its pixels. The wall spans only 156 px in the left panel, which is why the mesh is small there, and the 'enlarged' right panel is a 1.77x zoom in a panel two and a half times its width.

rubric_verdicts.contrast: pass: legend text is black on white (21:1); the plasma-cells legend swatch is drawn at 2.79:1, visibly darker than the 1.76:1 cells it names.
rubric_verdicts.data_ink: pass: three unfilled contour sets carry the ink, no fills or shading; ink covers 4.5 percent of the 1400x720 canvas.
rubric_verdicts.decoration: pass: no gridlines, background fill, gradient or theme; axes are off in both panels.
rubric_verdicts.label_collision: pass: the only text is the three-entry figure legend at top centre; nothing clipped, overlapping, or over the data.
rubric_verdicts.legibility: defect (non-blocking): coils, wall and divertor read at a glance in both panels, but the plasma mesh renders as a faint lavender texture; measured median contrast 1.76:1.
rubric_verdicts.table_form: pass: a poloidal geometry drawing, nothing that is naturally a table.
